description: What's technically possible now that wasn't before

signals.ai_agent_maturity: Agents can now DO things, not just chat. OpenClaw 300K GitHub stars proved demand
signals.multimodal_cost_collapse: DeepSeek V3 dropped token costs 90%. AI inference now cheap enough for consumer apps
signals.mcp_protocol_standard: MCP SDK 97M+ downloads/month. AI-to-tool connection standardized
signals.wechat_ecosystem_maturity: 400M+ mini-programs, 1B+ users. Verified service accounts can register 5 mini-programs instantly
signals.vibe_coding_reality: Non-developers shipping apps in hours. '小猫补光灯' 1 hour → #1 paid app
signals.single_file_apps_rising: HTML+JS single-file tools trending. No server needed. Just open in browser
signals.chrome_extension_gold_rush: Top extensions $20-130K/month. 7% monetized. Low competition in niche categories
signals.cli_tools_passive_income: Zig CLI tools made $82K in 3 months. Zero maintenance. One-time purchase
signals.open_source_funding_path: MiroFish: 10-day build → GitHub #1 → $4.2M funding. Validated path

emerging_frontiers: AI agent marketplaces (pre-trained agents for hire)
Personal AI 'employee' cloning (learn your style, handle tier-1)
Screenshot → action pipelines (AI reads your screen, does the work)
Multi-agent economic simulation (academic frontier, not yet productized)

_meta.collection_method: LLM聚合 GitHub/arXiv/技术媒体 公开信息，2026年6月
_meta.bias_declaration: 偏向AI/LLM技术栈，缺少硬件/生物/材料等硬科技维度。乐观估计技术成熟度。
limitations: 技术成熟度为定性判断
